personality_one_liner: A high-contrast, tactical command center that brings the energetic, data-dense aesthetic of a premium TV sports broadcast to mobile.

spacing.rule: Handle spacing correctly dont have extra spaces where its not required, handle padding and margin corectly and subtle for buttons and components

do's: Use glass overlay on the Home hero cold-open segment card to simulate a premium broadcast lower-third.
Use glass on the bottom tab bar when content scrolls behind it.
dont's: Do not use glass on dense data tables (Standings, Box Scores).
Do not use glass on standard stat panels or list rows.

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement '7 Dark-First Utility' personality. Use `Archivo Narrow` for all numbers, scores, ticker items, and display headings to simulate a TV broadcast graphic. Use `Manrope` for readable body text.
For the Ticker strip: Ensure it is edge-to-edge and uses a high-contrast format (e.g., `onSurface` text with `brandPrimary` highlights for live scores).

The 'Cold Open' and 'Talk' screens must visually distinguish the two hosts. Rayo: Warm/energetic styling (e.g., `brandTertiary` background or `brandPrimary` border). Casey: Cool/analytical styling (e.g., `surfaceTertiary` with `borderStrong`).

Branded-entity rule: Since the `image_selector_tool` failed to fetch real PNG logos for the MASL teams, MUST use the fallback Tier 3 (initials in a `surfaceTertiary` circle, e.g., 'BAL', 'SD', 'MIL') for team logos. Do NOT use vector icons for teams.

Apply the mandatory gradient-to-dark scrim pattern (vertical, transparent to >=70% surfaceInverse) over the `arena_hero` image on the Home screen to ensure the 'WATCH LIVE' CTA and white text are perfectly readable.
The Tactics Board graphic must strictly reflect boarded 6-a-side arena soccer (smaller pitch, rounded corners, boards visible, no standard outdoor sidelines).
Ensure touch targets are at least 44x44pt and all screens account for the safe area, avoiding content under the notch/status bar.
Never use indigo, purple, or any blue hues. Stick strictly to the defined Dark-First Utility palette with the 'Broadcast Red' brand accent.
